title: What Shapes User Trust in ChatGPT? A Mixed-Methods Study of User Attributes, Trust Dimensions, Task Context, and Societal Perceptions among University Students

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating participants' overall trust in ChatGPT with their trust in specific high-risk tasks that have known inaccuracies (such as reference/citation generation) to demonstrate over-reliance on confident model outputs.

bias_targets.target: Perceived societal and algorithmic bias (Racial and Cultural bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Using a mixed-methods approach that includes surveying users on their societal concerns regarding AI (e.g., bias and discrimination) and conducting semi-structured interviews to gather qualitative data on perceived model stereotypes, such as racial bias in image generation and Western-centric cultural bias in text models.
